note: Task DEFINITIONS only, in the MTEB/MMTEB standard task vocabulary. This register describes benchmark tasks so the benchmark pack can later score retrieval and reranking changes on task types the wiki's own golden set does not contain; the datasets themselves are not in this tree, and fetching one is a separate act under its own terms (see each task's reference and licence_note). The golden set (evaluation/golden-questions.jsonl) is not part of this register and is never touched by it. No MTEB code or dependency is imported — the vocabulary is used as data only.
pattern: MTEB / MMTEB (embeddings-benchmark/mteb, Apache-2.0) — tasks are declared in the framework's standard metadata vocabulary (type, eval_splits, eval_langs, main_score, date, reference, with language codes as ISO 639-3 + script, e.g. jpn-Jpan); definitions re-stated here in our own register shape after evaluation/beir-tasks.json, no code copied, no dataset downloaded or redistributed

tasks.definition: Given a query paper (title + abstract) and a candidate list of papers the first-stage retriever returned, rerank the candidates; the relevant candidates are the papers the query paper cites. Scored with the MTEB reranking task type's standard main score (map) over the recorded candidate lists — candidate lists are part of a fetched dataset, none is held here.
tasks.licence_note: Not verified in this register: the upstream dataset's own terms govern and are stated at its reference. No dataset files are held or redistributed here — this entry is a task definition only.
tasks.name: SciDocs Reranking (MTEB: SciDocsRR)

tasks.definition: Given a question written natively in Japanese (jpn-Jpan) or Korean (kor-Hang) and that language's Wikipedia passage corpus, retrieve the passages that answer it; relevance is judged per query in the dataset's own qrels. Scored with the MTEB retrieval task type's standard main score (ndcg_at_10). The JA/KO restriction is this register's slice choice: the two slices are recorded separately by eval_langs so a script-normalisation or tokenisation change for CJK / Hangul text is measured per language, never averaged away.
tasks.domain: Wikipedia passage retrieval, questions written natively per language (not translated)
tasks.licence_note: Not verified in this register: the upstream dataset's own terms govern and are stated at its reference. No dataset files are held or redistributed here — this entry is a task definition only.
tasks.mteb_task: MrTIDIRetrieval (restricted in this register to its jpn-Jpan and kor-Hang language slices)
tasks.name: Mr. TyDi Multilingual Retrieval — Japanese / Korean slices (MTEB: MrTIDIRetrieval)
